- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:127-134 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]

  WHY: Slow reads can monopolize the single-threaded relay and block other clients; severity differs (MAJOR versus NIT), so the highest is used.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:131 | severity=high | confidence=[4]

  WHY: Large rejected bodies can cause substantial memory allocation; severity differs or is unstated, so the highest stated severity is used.
